sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check all colors present
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
colors = {}
for n in nodes:
    c = n['color']
    colors[c] = colors.get(c, 0) + n['pixels']
print("Colors:", {k: v for k, v in sorted(colors.items())})

# Move LEFT 4 times
for i in range(4):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
    green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
    
    if result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Game over after LEFT {i+1}")
        break
    
    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: white={white}, green={len(green)}, pink={len(pink)}")
    
    if green:
        clicks = []
        for g in green:
            rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
            center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
            center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
            clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})
        action(clicks)
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
        green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
        print(f"  After clear: white={white}, green={len(green)}")

# Final state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nFinal: white={white}, green={len(green)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
